TOEIC® Listening and Reading — Practice Test 1

Tactics for TOEIC® (Oxford University Press) · 200 questions · Listening ≈ 45 min + Reading 75 min

No 75-minute limit or auto-submit; listening audio can be replayed; the timer just shows reading time used. Leave unchecked for real exam conditions.

How this test works

  • Listening (Parts 1–4): press the play button at the top of each part. In exam mode the audio plays one time only — no rewinding or replaying, just like the real test.
  • Reading (Parts 5–7): in exam mode a 75-minute timer starts the first time you open Part 5 and the test submits automatically at zero. The timer only counts while the test is open.
  • Click an answer to select it; click a different one to change it. Your answers are saved in this browser as you go, so an accidental refresh will not lose your work.
  • Continuing another day or on another computer: press Save progress (bottom of the screen) to download a progress file. Next time, use Load progress file on this screen to pick up where you left off.
  • When you finish, press Submit test. You will see your estimated TOEIC score, and a results file will download automatically — send that file to your teacher.
